author_headline: Leading Global SMB Solutions
summary: Samiran Dwivedi, an SMB solutions leader, unveils five agents—Slackbot, Piper, Momentum, Agentforce Coworker, Fin—at the SMB Keynote with guests from SaaStr AI and Perplexity.
post_text:
Dreamforce '26 is a wrap.

On the SMB Keynote stage, I talked about what customers actually ask me. It's never "does AI work?" It's "what job would I actually give it?"
So we didn't demo a platform. We introduced a digital team, five agents, five jobs:
→ Slackbot - answers from your CRM, in the channel you're already in
→ Piper - engages inbound buyers, follows up when they don't convert
→ Momentum - the data foundation that makes every agent and every rep smarter
→ Agentforce Coworker - an AI teammate in Lightning, live at the push of a button
→ Fin - resolves customer conversations autonomously, tuned to your rules out of the box

And we have SMBs who are taking advantage of all of this tech today and seeing tremendous ROI and revenue growth. A 40-person company can now field the same digital team as a 40,000-person one.

Thanks to Amelia Lerutte from SaaStr Ai and Nathan Follen from Perplexity for joining me on stage. Marlee Burton and Sabrina Skaggs for the amazing demo. And thank you to Jennifer Sei and Sharif Karmally and my co-presenters Adam Alfano, Whitney Hillyer, Giovanni Crispino and Des Traynor for the idea to delivery of our keynote.

post_text:
What happens when the biggest business software in the world crashes during its own annual party? Salesforce and Google Drive both suffered major disruptions on Wednesday during Day 2 of Dreamforce in San Francisco.

Here is what you need to know:

- A massive outage lasted over seven hours, locking global enterprises out of critical client records.

- The root cause was traced to a legacy login dependency that got overwhelmed by traffic.

- Analysts warn businesses now face data divergence, meaning hours of automated records, orders, and tickets must be reconciled by hand.

Are modern cloud platforms relying too heavily on hidden legacy code? Read the full story on Spark News to see what went wrong behind the scenes:
